title: AI Income Calculation for Self-Employed Borrowers: The Part of Underwriting Where the Math Has to Be Auditable
summary: Self-employed income is the hardest number in a loan file and the easiest one to get wrong. How to build an AI income engine that matches Fannie Mae Form 1084, holds up under ATR/QM, and carries an audit trail an underwriter and a model validator both trust.
